newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yizheng 1996 H2 hit by FCF Group loss.
newsitem.headline: Yizheng 1996 H2 hit by FCF Group loss.

text.p: Yizheng Chemical Fibre Co Ltd said on Monday a substantial loss in its wholly-owned Foshan Chemical Fibre Joint Corp (FCF Group) dampened the company's earning in the second half of 1996.

"We underestimated the loss in Foshan Chemical in the first half. After auditing we discovered the problem and this ate up part of our profits in the second half," managing director Ma Yuping told in a news conference.
He said FCF Group made a loss of more than 100 million yuan last year, bringing Yizheng's second half net profit down to 3.65 million yuan from 212 million in the first six months.
Yizheng earlier reported 1996 net profit of 215.65 million yuan, down 82 percent from the previous year.
But Ma said the company did not think the purchase of FCF Group in August 1995 was a mistake.
"We met some difficulties and for such a (small) size of company under this (negative) market condition, losses were unavoidable," he said.
FCF Group's products were mainly sold to the Guangdong market, which is close to Hong Kong and therefore imports moved in at a relatively fast pace.
"The speed of product-mix and management adjustments lagged a bit behind changes in market conditions," Ma said.
"After a shuffle of the management, they needed some time to establish relationships with customers and this increased the difficulty in operation and thus caused heavy losses," he added.
Yizheng would analyze the market and strengthen internal management to turnaround the loss-making situation of FCF Group, the managing director said.
Yizheng, China's largest polyester products maker, also expected a better year in 1997 since current market conditions seemed relatively stable compared with last year, he said.

Global supply of PTA (purified terephthalic acid) and PX (paraxylene) would increase substantially and might lead to lower costs even though international prices for the two raw material rose in the second quarter.
"In the second half of 1997, prices for PTA and PX are expected to decline while that for MEG (monoethylene glycol) may increase slightly," he said.
Yizheng's weighted average raw material price decreased by 32.28 percent last year from 1995 but the correction came after the impact on the fall of polyester product prices.
Its weighted average sales price decreased 37.11 percent in 1996 from 1995.

Ma also said Yizheng would be shouldering part of the losses incurred after selling quarters to its employees under Beijing's housing reform policy. But he did not say how big the loss would be and when it would be booked.
